lead.t: In Kenya the most used criteria are the IDF definition: central obesity (mandatory) plus any two of the following – elevated triglycerides, reduced HDL‑cholesterol, raised blood pressure, or impaired fasting glucose.

snip.t: In Kenya the most used criteria are the IDF definition: central obesity (mandatory) plus any two of the following – elevated triglycerides, reduced HDL‑cholesterol, raised blood pressure, or impaired fasting glucose.

Prediabetes is defined by impaired fasting glucose (IFG, fasting glucose 100-125 mg/dL [5.6-6.9 mmol/L]), impaired glucose tolerance (IGT, 2 hr postprandial glucose 140-199 mg/dL (7.8-11 mmol/L), or hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c ) values of 5.7–6.4% (39-47 mmol/mol).
| Fasting plasma glucose | Baseline glucose control | ≥5.6 mmol/L = impaired fasting glucose; ≥7.0 mmol/L = diabetes. |
